description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] if 0-3/4+ FF7 allies are alive, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Barret)] and [Ungarmax Mode] to the user, grants [VII Resonance +3% Boost] to all FFVII allies

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 30% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 30% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 30% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 30% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 30% (15s)], [Imperil Water 30% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 30% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 30% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 30% (15s)]

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Barret)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Fire abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Fire abilities

description.name: Ungarmax Mode
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire] to the user after using two Fire abilities

description.name: VII Resonance +3% Boost
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 3% if the character's Realm is VII

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Barret)] and [Soul Break Gauge +250], removes [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Barret)]
